hytale-startup-flow.html.title: Hytale Startup Flow
hytale-startup-flow.html.description:
Load Early PluginsLoad Mixins (if present)Init logging and file handlerpre-launch checks
QUIC availability
Java Thread settings
LOG: Starting Hytaleserver(various internal configuration settings are set here)
serverContext - name, max-players
universeContext - path, player-count, world list
pluginsContext - list of plugins, state (enabled/disabled/failed), versions
packsContext - version and manifest data about assetpacks
"unknown" - server hardware UUID, auth mod, Hytale username/UUID for selected profile, IP address?
"scope" - hardware UUID (again?), OS name and version, HytaleServer version/revision/patchline/environment This data is sent to Hytale on server startup, unless Sentry is disabled. Sentry can be disabled by: option flags
by the presence of early plugins
by running a "development build" (probably a way for Hytale employees to not flood Sentry) Sentry Telemetry(additional internal init() calls, a couple TrigMathUtil calls, for some reason? also some early setup for a shutdown hook)AssetRegistryLoader.init()Core Plugin RegistrationCore Plugin RegistrationLOG: Booting up HytaleServer - Version <ver>, Revision: <rev>??? this.sendSingleplayerProgress()LOG: Setup phase...commandManager.registerCommands()pluginManager.setup()Register DataStoreProvider codec
Currently only one option: DiskDataStoreProvider
LOG: Loading Config...
(load cfg from file)LOG: Authentication mode: %s
(ServerAuthManager.getInstance().initialize() is called here to enable auth, but CredentialStore is not initialized until later)Initialize ServerAuthManager's CredentialStoreDispatch LoadAssetEvent[!] LOG: SEVERE - Asset validation FAILED with X reason(s):[!] possible shutdown point?LOG: Asset validation passedLOG: Failed to launch with transforming classloader
OR
LateMain.lateMain() threw an exceptionProcess Server-wide and per-world configsLOG: client.disconnection.shutdownReason.shutdown.schemaGenerated???
this.sendSingleplayerProgress()LOG: Starting plugin manager...pluginManager.start()this.reportSingleplayerStatus()save any changes made to server configUniverse.get().getUniverseReady().join()LOG: Universe Ready!apply SP/MP and "fresh universe" tags (?)wait for "bind complete" (presumably port binding?)Dispatch BootEventExecute Boot Commands (if any were set at command line)LOG: Hytale Server Booted!updateModule.onServerReady()Get AuthMode (if not SP server) and prompt for server token if needed

info_showOrphanNodes.description: Show nodes that are not connected to any other nodes.

info_showAttachments.description: Show attachments like images and PDFs as nodes in the graph.

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: Allow the user to view the global graph of all nodes.

info_allowExpand.description: Allow the user to pop-out the graph view to take up the whole screen

info_attractionForce.description: How much should linked nodes attract each other? This will make the graph appear more clustered.

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_edgePruning.description: Edges with a length above this threshold will not be rendered, however they will still contribute to the simulation. This can help large tangled graphs look more organised. Hovering over a node will still display these links.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
